'''AfroBank FM''' is a radio station due to appear in {{VI}}. The station features African music, including classics, amapiano, and 3-step, and is hosted by [[Burna]] and [[Palmsy]].<ref name="GTAVIRadio">[https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/music/flash-fm ''The Music of Grand Theft Auto VI: In-Game Radio Stations''] ''Rockstar Games'', October 8, 2026.</ref>

==Description==
The radio station was revealed on the [[GTA VI Website|Grand Theft Auto VI website]] in a Newswire post announcing some of the radio stations in Leonida. [[Rockstar Games]] describes AfroBank FM as featuring African music ranging from 20th-century classics and lesser-known tracks to contemporary genres such as amapiano and 3-step. The station is hosted by Burna and Palmsy.<ref name="GTAVIRadio"/>
